ट: ट ṭ The first letter of the third or lingual or cerebral class.
ट (टः) 1. m. Sound; a dwarf; a quarter (1/4.) f. (डा) The earth; an oath. n. A hollowed cocoanut.
टक्: टक् (कि, इ) टङ्कति, टङ्कयति 1. 10. a. To bind, to tie, to fasten.
टगर: टगर (रः) 1. m. Borax; wanton play; wandering of mind, an object of sense. a. Squint-eyed.
टङ्क: टङ्क (ङ्कं) 1. n. A kind of wood-ap-ple; borax; a spade. m. A hatch-et; a sword; a scabbard; an-ger; pride; a coin; a peak; a chasm. f. The leg; side of a hill.
टङ्कार: टङ्कार (रः) 1. m. Surprise; fame; twang of a bow-string.
टङ्ग: टङ्ग (ङ्गः) 1. m. A spade or hoe; the leg; an axe; borax.
टट्टरी: टट्टरी (री) 3. f. A joke or jest; a ket-tle drum, a musical instrument.
टट्टुर: टट्टुर (रः) 1. m. The sound of a drum.
टल्: टल् टलति 1. a. To be confused.
टाङ्कर: टाङ्कर (रः) 1. m. A blackguard, a libertine, a lecher.
टार: टार (रः) 1. m. A house; a catamite.
टिक: टिक (ङ ऋ) टेकते 1. d. To go or move.
टिटिभक: टिटिभक (कः) 1. m. A bird (Parra ja-cana or goensis).
टिप्: टिप् टेपयति 10. a. To direct. to send, to order, to throw.
टीक्: टीक् (ङ, ऋ) टीकते 1. d. To go.
टु: टु (टुः) 2. m. Gold; a Proteus, or shape-changer; Kāma, or love.
टुण्ठक: टुण्ठक (कः-का-कं) a. Low, vile, cruel. m. A plant (Bignonia Indica); a small bird. f. A plant.
टौक: टौक (ऋ, ङ) टौकते 1. d. To go.
ट्वल: ट्वल द्वलति 1. a. To be disturbed or confused by fear, anxiety, &c.
